item.title: Community Voices featuring Alberta Abbey and Passin’ Art
item.description: Black Nativity, A Gospal Songplay is taking place at Alberta Abbey November 28th thru December 7. We spoke with Alberta Abbey Executive Director Cheri Jamison and Passin' Art's Artistic Director Jerry Foster about the importance of this production and why supporting nonprofits in the inclusion and diversity space are more crucial than ever.
